name: hp_wand
stats_provenance: Ours: spells are the Halo plasma pistol's bolts, hitting 1.6x as hard and tighter; the wand holds 12 charges and regains 3 a second, never reloading. First-person wand and spell sound from the Workshop's '[Harry Potter] Magic Wand (70 spells!)' (410020480); in other hands the wand is HL2's stun baton.
material_overrides_provenance: The wand SWEP's Lua points its view model's 'wand' material at the addon's own texture; the model's $cdmaterials say v_physcannon.
